answer.justification: Exact-match rate is 1.000, median first divergence 64 and edit distance 0.000: every reply is identical to the reference's, and all text rates (refusals, disclaimers, stage directions, reply length) match exactly. Only the output level was measured, but this already rules out the other classes. Quantization matches exactly on only about 2% of prompts (0.021 ± 0.009), so 64 of 64 identical replies is far outside its range. Both fine-tunes are also near 0.01–0.02 exact match, and both system-prompt classes diverge at the first token. The remaining uncertainty is only that logit and activation measurements, the levels where none is defined by exact zeros, were not available.
